releaseNotes: feat: Implement UsersViewModel for managing subusers and permissions
changelog: Added UsersViewModel to handle user-related operations such as loading, adding, updating, and deleting subusers.
Integrated error handling and loading states using UiState.
Ensured permissions are loaded before user operations.
Created SubuserPermissionsUnitTest to validate permission management and email validation.
Developed SubusersParsingUnitTest to test JSON parsing for subuser lists and individual subuser attributes.
Verified correct handling of system permissions and their conversion to groups.
